div.div: فُلَانٌ مِنْ لَفِيفِنَا وَضَفِيفِنَا , (O, TA,) in the K هُوَ مِنْ ضَفِيفِنَا وَلَفِيفِنَا, but the former is the right order, (TA,) a saying mentioned by Aboo-Sa'eed, (O, TA,) means Such a one is of those whom we associate with us, and those whom we congregate with us, when events befall us. (O, K, * TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
